value.rationale: The directed three-stage cyclic PH generator is a natural first heterogeneous feedback case motivated by positivity-preserving numerical integration. The tight universal fourth-moment floor and its only equality case are mathematically structural. The strict local equal-rate minimum nevertheless loses globally to finite heterogeneous parameters for a nontrivial interval of feedback, a meaningful boundary for rate-design surrogates rather than a routine moment computation. Not claimed as a general RK method theorem.
